summary.text: Frank Carroll, a Republican, represents District 28 in the Arizona State Senate, which he joined on January 9, 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Carroll was born in Chicago, Illinois, and lives in Arizona.
His career experience includes working as a service mechanic for a forklift and construction equipment dealer in Chicago and operating commercial motor coaches for the tourism industry.
